verdict.rationale: ClickUp's documented MCP server lets external AI agents work with workspace tasks, lists, folders and docs using natural language, including concrete actions like time tracking and building reports. In-product, Brain² answers complex questions across the workspace and Super Agent claims to take delegated tasks. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on which in-app actions Brain²/Super Agent can execute from natural-language commands (beyond answering questions), independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
